lanes.name: unit
lanes.description: In-process pytest over tests/unit and tests/contract. Contract tests use FastAPI TestClient (httpx, already a transitive dep) against the real router tree, so they stay in-process and need no port.

lanes.name: e2e
lanes.description: Playwright via pytest-playwright against a live reader3-server started by the live_server fixture in tests/e2e/conftest.py (free port, --port, READER3_BOOKS_DIR -> tmp, polls /api/health). gateOn was EMPTY until 2026-08-26: an empty tests/e2e/ makes the lane report 'never passed' forever, which denies every push and trains everyone into permanent TDD_GUARD_BYPASS=1. The 009 harness spike added the first test and restored gateOn to ["push"] in the same commit, as required. Do not set READER3_TOKEN for this lane: the frontend fetch does not carry the token yet, so the token gate would 401 every write.

lanes.name: packaging
lanes.description: Builds a wheel, installs it into a clean venv with dependencies resolved at LATEST (uv.lock deliberately not used), starts a real reader3-server and hits four routes. The only place in the repo that would notice a dependency major bump breaking the installed app -- uv run and the unit lane both go through the pinned lock and stay green. ~50s measured 2026-09-03 (an earlier note said ~17s; that predates the current dependency set and the latest-version resolution it does on every run). Still gates on push, not on commit -- and the gap is the reason: at 17s someone would argue for moving it to commit, at 50s nobody will.
